verdict.rationale: Antigravity documents background execution: cron-scheduled tasks where agents run autonomously in the background, scheduled messages to agents while you are away, and parallel agents. It also offers isolation through Git worktrees that act as isolated background folders and a CLI sandbox that blocks sensitive files. However, all evidence points to local or desktop execution (Remote Control drives desktop sessions on your own machines), with no hosted cloud environment for delegated tasks. Missing for 10: an isolated cloud execution environment, managed remote or hosted task runs, and independent corroboration of background long-running task delegation.
